chief_data.selection_justification: Selected because heat transfer and productivity are improved over batch, achieving 6.2x residence-time reduction at acceptable pressure-drop and safety risk.
chief_data.selection_rationale: Candidate 3 was selected with a combined score of 0.842, driven by its high fluidics score (0.950) and safety score (0.920), indicating robust performance in enhanced laminar mixing and safety margins. Candidate 1, with a score of 0.821, was held back by a lower chemistry score (0.330), while Candidate 2, scoring 0.808, had a lower fluidics score (0.700). The user objective of balanced performance favored Candidate 3 due to its superior safety and fluidics scores. The most important remaining uncertainties include the estimation of the reaction rate constant from batch data and the unverified flow enhancement factor. The first experiment should verify the flow enhancement by running a blank solvent at the design flow rate for 30 minutes, then switching to the reaction mixture and sampling at t=3τ and t=5τ.
